entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Anuj Pratap Singh,Suresh C. Dwivedi
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to de-notify the petitioner' land bearing Arazi No. 179, area 0.244 hectare, village Birtiyan Bithoor,
Pargana, Tehsil Billaour, District Kanpur Nagar, as per order dated 01.05.2019.
2. It appears that the aforesaid land was notified for acquisition under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
However no award was made in respect of the said land so far.
According to the petitioner, its physical possession is also with him.

The petitioner filed Writ No. 36333 of 2016 (Kishan Lal & Another vs. State of U.P. & Others) and it was disposed of by order dated 05.08.2016 with liberty to the petitioner to move appropriate application before District Magistrate, in terms of Government Order dated 30.01.2015 and in which event, it will be decided by the State Government Kishan Lal vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 14 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/179393307/
1 within six weeks.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Kishan Lal vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: According to the petitioner, in pursuance of the said order, an order was passed on 01.05.2019 by Principal Secretary, U.P., Government, Industrial Development, Anubhag 3 for forwarding proposal for de-notification under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. On 20.07.2023 a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court passed the following order:
"Instructions filed by Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Corporation, be kept on record.

entities.text: Uttar Pradesh State Industrial Development Corporation
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: There is a communication dated 1 May, 2019 by which the State Government itself has requested for the denotification of the land in question.
Sri S.C. Dwivedi, learned counsel has passed on instructions which indicate that Government is sitting over the proposal sent by the District Magistrate.
Sri Dilip Kesarwani, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel may take further instructions in the matter.

Put up as fresh on 08.08.2023 before the appropriate Bench."
4.

Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel is in receipt of written instructions dated 30.08.2023 from Special Secretary, U.P. Government mentioning that the proposal sent at that time remained pending but now the State Government is in process of taking decision.
It will take two months time.

5. Considering the aforesaid stand of the State Government, we dispose of the instant petition granting two months time to take final decision on basis of the recommendation contained in letter dated 01.05.2019 and the proposal for de-notification sent by the District Magistrate, Kanpur Nagar dated 12.07.2019 and communicate the same to the petitioner.
(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 14.9.2023

Ruhi H.
